exchange.sent: What evidence is required to compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for Semiconductor without making unsupported claims?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
The required evidence is a same-scope, traceable comparison package: exact R&S VNA model/options/spec conditions, exact competitor model/options/spec conditions from official or validated third-party sources, and a clearly defined semiconductor use case/DUT with identical measurement conditions; the current passages show R&S ZNA specifications are documented, but competitor VNA specifications and semiconductor comparison evidence are not sufficiently documented for supported comparative claims [5][28][30][32][35][45].
### Evidence required before making a comparison claim
| Evidence needed | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| Exact R&S VNA model, configuration, options, and document version | R&S ZNA specifications are tied to document PD 5215.4652.22, Version 24.00, April 2026, and the ZNA family includes ZNA26, ZNA43, ZNA50, and ZNA67 with defined frequency ranges and 2-port / 4-port configurations [3][5]. | Supported for R&S ZNA specs, but the comparison must cite the exact chosen model and options rather than treating “ZNA” as one undifferentiated product [3][61]. |
| R&S specification conditions, not just headline numbers | Product data applies only after 3 hours storage at ambient temperature, 90 minutes warm-up, specified environmental conditions, recommended calibration interval, and applicable internal automatic adjustments [60][62]. | Supported for R&S; any comparison must use the same or explicitly comparable test conditions [60][62]. |
| Clear distinction between warranted and non-warranted R&S data | Specifications with limits and specifications without limits indicate warranted product performance, while non-traceable specifications, typical data, nominal values, and measured values are not guaranteed by Rohde & Schwarz [1]. | Supported for R&S; comparison claims must not treat typical, nominal, or measured values as guaranteed specifications [1]. |
| Exact competitor product model, option code, specs, and test conditions | The current Keysight ENA and PNA passages identify ENA/PNA only as product series names in a PCB test context and state that no concrete model, frequency range, option code, calibration kit, TDR option, performance metrics, measurement accuracy, dynamic range, or bandwidth is provided [31][32][34][35]. | Not currently supported for a technical competitor comparison [32][35]. |
| Competitor evidence from official or validated third-party sources | The Keysight page states that an R&S battle card’s competitor descriptions need Keysight official data or third-party data verification, and that the battle card does not provide formal Keysight datasheets, document versions, order numbers, option codes, release status, or test conditions [28]. | Not currently supported by official competitor evidence in the provided passages [28][30]. |
| Semiconductor-specific use case and DUT definition | The passages include semiconductor-adjacent leads such as Bare Board for SoCs with PCB probing for impedance, insertion loss, and return loss, and a sales strategy noting Bare board for SoCs (RFIC) with VNA fit [45][50]. | The same passages do not provide full DUT specifications, frequency range, probe model, fixture, or de-embedding workflow for that SoC use case [51]. |
| Direct evidence that both R&S and competitor solutions address the same semiconductor measurement problem | The LSmtron case lists Products: ZNB40, Competitor: Keysight ENA, total solution with probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool, and DUT: Board to Board Connector [47]. | This is a direct competitor mention, but it is not a semiconductor SoC case and lacks ZNB40 formal model, order number, frequency range, or configuration evidence [46][47]. |
| Same measurement metrics and conditions on both sides | R&S ZNA67 effective system and measurement accuracy data are tied to conditions such as +18 °C to +28 °C, calibration temperature change ≤ 1 °C, 10 Hz measurement bandwidth, nominal source power 0 dBm, same frequency points / bandwidth / sweep time for calibration and measurement, and no calibration interpolation [82][83]. | Comparable competitor data with the same metrics and conditions is not provided in the Keysight ENA/PNA passages [32][35]. |
| Fixture, calibration, probe, de-embedding, and topology evidence | Existing case material notes missing topology, extender, probe, calibration, de-embedding, fixture, or DUT conditions for a 67 GHz stability claim, and says such a claim cannot be treated as a standalone instrument specification [43]. | Required before claiming semiconductor application performance or superiority [43][51]. |
| Source provenance: date, version, publisher, and page context | Several source summaries state that formal dates, versions, authors, page numbers, original URLs, or document versions are missing, and converted dates must not be treated as content dates [38][41][45]. | Required to avoid presenting incomplete sales or image material as validated current product evidence [38][41]. |
| No R&S-vs-Keysight conclusion unless the source supports it | The 112G PAM4 PCB engineering summary says the source is insufficient to compare Keysight and R&S or establish a procurement configuration [22]. | Current passages do not support a broad R&S vs Keysight semiconductor VNA comparison [22][30][32][35]. |

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 與既有知識的關係
- 本來源補齊 [[R&S ZNA]] 主系列，與既有 [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 形成關聯：[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是 1.0 mm Vector Network Analyzer System，量測範圍 10 MHz to 110 GHz；本來源的 [[R&S ZNA67]] 是 67 GHz base VNA 型號，並可透過 [[mmWave converter support]] 與 accessories 延伸應用。
- 本來源與既有 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWP]]、[[R&S FSWX]] 等 spectrum / phase-noise analyzer 頁面在 [[Spectrum analyzer mode]]、[[Phase noise]]、[[Noise figure measurement]] 等功能上有橫向關聯，但本來源屬於 VNA 產品規格，不應與市場或技術背景合併。
- [[R&S ZNA-K980]] HUMS 與既有其他產品頁的 [[Health and utilization monitoring service]] 有橫向關聯；本來源列出 SNMP、REST JSON、SCPI、device web 等 readout/display protocols。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 重點摘要
- 型號頻率範圍：
  - [[R&S ZNA26]]：10 MHz to 26.5 GHz。
  - [[R&S ZNA43]]：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz，可為 2.92 mm 或 2.4 mm ruggedized male test port connector。
  - [[R&S ZNA50]]：10 MHz to 50 GHz。
  - [[R&S ZNA67]]：10 MHz to 67 GHz。
- 各型號提供 2 ports 或 4 ports base unit；test port impedance 為 50 Ω，DC block 為 standard。
- Key performance 包含：dynamic range > 129 dB specification without options、147 dB typical with options、maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction；sensitivity > –120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth specification without options，並有 –162 dBm measured with options（1 kHz measurement bandwidth normalized to 1 Hz）。
- Measurement bandwidth：base unit 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz；搭配 [[R&S ZNA-K17]] increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz option 時為 1 Hz to 30 MHz。
- Measurement speed 條件包含 firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)；例：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。
- 4-port instruments：最多 4 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 5 source 可作為 LO supply；每 port 有 2 true receivers，4-port model 總計 8 true receivers，無 multiplexing。
- 2-port instruments：最多 2 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 3 source 可作為 LO supply；每 port 有 2 true receivers，2-port model 總計 4 true receivers，無 multiplexing。
- Optional rear panel LO out 可支援 mmWave converters；4-port model 最多 4 個 converters，2-port model 最多 2 個 converters，無需 external signal generator；rear panel LO out typ. +25 dBm，最高 26.5 GHz。
- [[R&S ZNA-K28]] continuous data recording 支援 infinite data point capture、circular buffer，並可透過 LAN 或 USB 連續資料傳輸。
- [[R&S ZNA-B26]] direct IF access：IF input 可用於 mmWave converter 與 antenna measurement systems，bandwidth 1 GHz；IF output up to 2 GHz bandwidth 可用於 external pulse analysis。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。
- Speed example：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。

R&S ZNA › Measurement speed
- Measurement speed 測試條件：firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)。
- Acquisition time per point：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog wideband 時 1 µs；30 MHz measurement bandwidth 時 32 ns。
- Linear frequency sweep 條件 201 points、10 GHz center frequency、200 MHz span：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog normal 時 time per sweep < 3.9 ms；sweep cycle time < 4.9 ms。
- IEC/IEEE VXI11 over 1 Gbit/s LAN：201 measurement points、800 MHz start frequency、1 GHz stop frequency、1 MHz measurement bandwidth 的 measurement and data transfer time 為 14 ms / 13 ms；201 measurement points magnitude 的 data transfer time 為 1.7 ms / 0.9 ms。
- Switching time between channels with a maximum of 2001 points：< 2 ms。
- Continuous mode 不需要額外 data transfer time，因為 data transfer 與 measurement 同時進行。

- Power range without optional source step attenuator：
  - 10 MHz to 4 GHz：–80 dBm to +17 dBm；typ. up to +20 dBm。

R&S ZNA43 › Measurement accuracy 條件與摘錄
R&S®ZNA43 measurement accuracy 的共通有效條件：+18 °C to +28 °C；calibration 後溫度變化不超過 1 °C；frequency points、measurement bandwidth、sweep time 必須與 measurement 和 calibration 相同；不使用 interpolation of the calibration；base unit without options 條件為 measurement bandwidth 10 Hz、nominal source power 0 dBm。

R&S ZNA50
[[R&S ZNA50]] 是 [[R&S ZNA]] 系列的 50 GHz Vector Network Analyzer 型號，依 Version 24.00（April 2026）規格書提供 2-port 與 4-port base unit。

R&S ZNA50 › 基本規格
- Frequency range：10 MHz to 50 GHz。
- Test port connector：2.4 mm, male, ruggedized。
- Number of test ports：2 or 4。
- Impedance：50 Ω。
- DC block：standard。
- Frequency resolution：1 Hz。
- Number of measurement points per trace：1 to 100001。
- Measurement bandwidth：base unit 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz；with [[R&S ZNA-K17]] increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz option 時為 1 Hz to 30 MHz。

R&S ZNA67 › Software options
[[R&S ZNA67]] 可使用 [[R&S ZNA]] 系列 software / measurement options。需注意 [[R&S ZNA-K1]] spectrum analyzer mode 不能與 R&S®ZNA67-B312、R&S®ZNA67-B511 組合；此限制為來源原文列出的 excludes / cannot be combined 關係。

[[R&S ZNA67]] 與既有 [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 相關但不是同一頁：[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是 1.0 mm Vector Network Analyzer System，依既有 index 記錄量測範圍 10 MHz to 110 GHz；本頁為 67 GHz base VNA 型號。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

- 型號頻率範圍：
  - [[R&S ZNA26]]：10 MHz to 26.5 GHz。
  - [[R&S ZNA43]]：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz，可為 2.92 mm 或 2.4 mm ruggedized male test port connector。
  - [[R&S ZNA50]]：10 MHz to 50 GHz。

- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。

### Short answer
The required evidence is a same-scope, traceable comparison package: exact R&S VNA model/options/spec conditions, exact competitor model/options/spec conditions from official or validated third-party sources, and a clearly defined semiconductor use case/DUT with identical measurement conditions; the current passages show R&S ZNA specifications are documented, but competitor VNA specifications and semiconductor comparison evidence are not sufficiently documented for supported comparative claims [5][28][30][32][35][45].
### Evidence required before making a comparison claim
| Evidence needed | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| Exact R&S VNA model, configuration, options, and document version | R&S ZNA specifications are tied to document PD 5215.4652.22, Version 24.00, April 2026, and the ZNA family includes ZNA26, ZNA43, ZNA50, and ZNA67 with defined frequency ranges and 2-port / 4-port configurations [3][5]. | Supported for R&S ZNA specs, but the comparison must cite the exact chosen model and options rather than treating “ZNA” as one undifferentiated product [3][61]. |
| R&S specification conditions, not just headline numbers | Product data applies only after 3 hours storage at ambient temperature, 90 minutes warm-up, specified environmental conditions, recommended calibration interval, and applicable internal automatic adjustments [60][62]. | Supported for R&S; any comparison must use the same or explicitly comparable test conditions [60][62]. |
| Clear distinction between warranted and non-warranted R&S data | Specifications with limits and specifications without limits indicate warranted product performance, while non-traceable specifications, typical data, nominal values, and measured values are not guaranteed by Rohde & Schwarz [1]. | Supported for R&S; comparison claims must not treat typical, nominal, or measured values as guaranteed specifications [1]. |
| Exact competitor product model, option code, specs, and test conditions | The current Keysight ENA and PNA passages identify ENA/PNA only as product series names in a PCB test context and state that no concrete model, frequency range, option code, calibration kit, TDR option, performance metrics, measurement accuracy, dynamic range, or bandwidth is provided [31][32][34][35]. | Not currently supported for a technical competitor comparison [32][35]. |
| Competitor evidence from official or validated third-party sources | The Keysight page states that an R&S battle card’s competitor descriptions need Keysight official data or third-party data verification, and that the battle card does not provide formal Keysight datasheets, document versions, order numbers, option codes, release status, or test conditions [28]. | Not currently supported by official competitor evidence in the provided passages [28][30]. |
| Semiconductor-specific use case and DUT definition | The passages include semiconductor-adjacent leads such as Bare Board for SoCs with PCB probing for impedance, insertion loss, and return loss, and a sales strategy noting Bare board for SoCs (RFIC) with VNA fit [45][50]. | The same passages do not provide full DUT specifications, frequency range, probe model, fixture, or de-embedding workflow for that SoC use case [51]. |
| Direct evidence that both R&S and competitor solutions address the same semiconductor measurement problem | The LSmtron case lists Products: ZNB40, Competitor: Keysight ENA, total solution with probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool, and DUT: Board to Board Connector [47]. | This is a direct competitor mention, but it is not a semiconductor SoC case and lacks ZNB40 formal model, order number, frequency range, or configuration evidence [46][47]. |
| Same measurement metrics and conditions on both sides | R&S ZNA67 effective system and measurement accuracy data are tied to conditions such as +18 °C to +28 °C, calibration temperature change ≤ 1 °C, 10 Hz measurement bandwidth, nominal source power 0 dBm, same frequency points / bandwidth / sweep time for calibration and measurement, and no calibration interpolation [82][83]. | Comparable competitor data with the same metrics and conditions is not provided in the Keysight ENA/PNA passages [32][35]. |
| Fixture, calibration, probe, de-embedding, and topology evidence | Existing case material notes missing topology, extender, probe, calibration, de-embedding, fixture, or DUT conditions for a 67 GHz stability claim, and says such a claim cannot be treated as a standalone instrument specification [43]. | Required before claiming semiconductor application performance or superiority [43][51]. |
| Source provenance: date, version, publisher, and page context | Several source summaries state that formal dates, versions, authors, page numbers, original URLs, or document versions are missing, and converted dates must not be treated as content dates [38][41][45]. | Required to avoid presenting incomplete sales or image material as validated current product evidence [38][41]. |
| No R&S-vs-Keysight conclusion unless the source supports it | The 112G PAM4 PCB engineering summary says the source is insufficient to compare Keysight and R&S or establish a procurement configuration [22]. | Current passages do not support a broad R&S vs Keysight semiconductor VNA comparison [22][30][32][35]. |

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
